hypothesis: Adopting an exact maximum-weight non-overlapping matching in place of official greedy, only when it has >= greedy cardinality and strictly greater observable score sum, improves realized MSMI/100 on unseen seeds.
interpretation_boundary: The gate proves observable-objective improvement only; MSMI improvement is the empirical hypothesis under test.

candidate.greedy_baseline_allocation: sort (-score, pair_key), take non-overlapping, zero-score pairs included
candidate.exact_solver: hungarian O(n^3) e-maxx/vorobyev, pure python, zero-weight real pairs retained
candidate.ungated_ablation: adopt K_exact whenever exact_available, else greedy; no gate

freshness_audit.note: 200 excluded as ambiguous (appears in multiple contexts)

primary_metric: summarise.primary_score = msmi_per_100_arrived_members equally averaged over 6 families

statistics.ci: two-sided t, df=11; primary 95% (t=2.201); also report 99% (t=3.106)
statistics.primary_claim: single superiority claim gated_mw vs greedy; no multiplicity correction; ungated contrast is descriptive ablation

promotion_criteria.P4_no_family_catastrophe: every family paired-mean diff >= -0.20 msmi/100 absolute
promotion_criteria.P5_validity: determinism across PYTHONHASHSEED {0,1,random}; local/container parity on gated arm; every invoke < 10 s; mean invoke < 2 s

fail_behavior: Any criterion fails -> keep greedy; report honestly; no redesign.
stopping_rule: Full grid, no interim looks. Invalid episode -> stop, document, defect-only fix, rerun affected worlds.

calibration.diagnostic: MSMI conversion by score band with counts + Wilson 95% CI, separate replay pass, never used for tuning

close_line_criterion: Promotion criteria fail -> close allocation-method line; keep greedy; no post-hoc successor.
